activity_summary: At the cold Theatre Ralph Raye showed a Rose bill for Seleo and Olympo and said the flag was up over the Bankside. He would not give a figure from a book he did not see. Kemp said you stop like Christians while they take three pound. Heminges said the Mayor counts which house played in Lent, and that a season may have a name without every tradesman stopping at once. You said Henslowe will be shut within a fortnight. You did not cross the river, and you named no total in your own book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Called the idleness obedience, refused Henslowe's book, and said a fortnight.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Said the three pounds, and would not round them.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Kept the stage empty, named the Mayor's count, and would not invent a fine.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: Ralph Raye brought the bill, reported the flag, and refused a sum he did not see.

entities.name: Seleo and Olympo
entities.context: Mentioned in The flag, not the book

facets.activity: Heard the Bankside flag and stayed this side of the river

speakers: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: We stop like Christians and they take three pound for it.

quotes.speaker: hired_men
quotes.text: I saw the flag. I did not see his book.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: A season may have a name without every tradesman stopping at once.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Henslowe will be shut within a fortnight, and we shall all be equally idle.
